cells.gaps: The 51,601 young people the government's youth programme trained since 2023 are not placed in more than one location by any source. No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills.
cells.note: The government's youth programme counts 51,601 young people given digital skills since 2023, and the GENIE project opened 35 centres in 2025. No source places the counted training in more than one location, so not stage 3.
